subject.why: The golden royal crown is instantly recognizable, tilted as requested, and features the red and blue jewels along with the heart-shaped ruby at the front.

category.why: The crown floats cleanly in the air with no floor or ground, shown in a three-quarter tilted view against a saturated radiating sunburst pattern.

clean.why: There is no text, UI elements, borders, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The crown is nicely centered with ample margins on all sides and nothing is cut off.

colour.why: The gold of the crown contrasts sharply against the warm, saturated red-orange background.

detail.why: The jewels and crown structure are kept chunky and smooth with no micro-textures, noise, or unnecessary props.

style.why: Matches the references perfectly with smooth chunky 3D volumes, clean highlights, and a soft satin finish.
